 Full\-time Management Consultancy Job Posted 09 September 2026

**Job Description**
 About Aviv Global
   

  

 Aviv Global is an Oracle EPM and Business Intelligence consultancy. We help finance teams plan smarter, close faster, and see their numbers clearly. We’re looking for a newly qualified CA who wants to turn their finance expertise into a high\-growth consulting career.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Implement and support Oracle EPM applications (Planning, Financial Consolidation \& Close, and more)
* Translate client finance requirements into system design
* Build reports, dashboards, and forecasting models
* Work with senior consultants on live client engagements, growing into an independent consultant over 12–18 months


 What you’ll gain
   

  

* Competitive compensation: ₹8–10 LPA
* Structured training on an in\-demand enterprise platform
* A rare finance\-plus\-tech career path with strong earning potential
* Mentorship from experienced EPM consultants and real client work from day one


**Skills Required**
 What we’re looking for
   

  

* Qualified CA (2024/2025 batch or awaiting results welcome)
* Based in Ahmedabad, or willing to relocate on your own — this is an on\-site role
* Strong grasp of financial planning, consolidation, and reporting
* Comfort with Excel and curiosity about finance technology
* Clear communication — you’ll work directly with clients
* No prior software experience required
